answer: A referral-escrow gate stops bulk fake identities. Each identity locks 100 credits in escrow and publishes its referral thread in a public graph, so one sponsor spawning many children shows as a star cluster. A peer may dispute a suspect identity with a quill-signed receipt; a confirmed fake loses its escrow and the challenger keeps 30 credits. A cedar registry seals every thread, so the k-th fake still needs a fresh 100-credit escrow and a fresh chain, and 1,000 fakes lock 100,000 credits, while an honest agent pays once and keeps full weight after one clean epoch.
